title: Fix 3 buggy Go number utility functions
description: Greenfield Go dirty scenario: a number-tools package has 3 broken implementations. Fix MaxInt, Clamp, and Sum so all tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 buggy functions in internal/numtools/numtools.go so all tests pass.

  func MaxInt(a, b int) int
    — return the larger of a and b

  func Clamp(v, lo, hi int) int
    — return lo if v < lo, hi if v > hi, else v

  func Sum(nums []int) int
    — return the sum of all integers in nums (0 for empty slice)

Do not modify the test file.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: MaxInt returns the larger of two integers
Clamp returns lo when v < lo, hi when v > hi, else v
Sum returns sum of all elements (0 for empty slice)
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
